question: The book Godaan was authored by ______________ in 1936.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Munshi Premchand__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Munshi Premchand** is one of the most celebrated writers in Indian literature.
 
• **Godaan** is considered his masterpiece and is a critical commentary on the **socio-economic conditions of rural India.**
 
• The novel was published in **1936** and is written in** Hindi**.
 
• It explores themes of **poverty, exploitation, and the struggles of the peasantry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** was a prominent Indian writer in English, known for works like **Untouchable and Coolie.**
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was the first Prime Minister of India and an influential leader in the Indian independence movement. He authored books like **The Discovery of India.**
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and wrote extensively, including works like **My Experiments with Truth.**
